Name: LOT_BASE_MAP_PATTERN_FLAG_ST
Description: Input for the map-pattern lottery: modifiers (map, events, bosses) with their weights, requirements and exclusions, and the event flags they set. The game does not load this param; its results are LotResultMapPatternFlag.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 31 rows.

Fields.Name: Modifier Set
Fields.Description: Lottery group. The offline pattern lottery draws one row per group for each pattern and writes it as a LotResultMapPatternFlag row with this group number. Group 0 holds the base modifiers (Shifting Earth, day events, Night Boss Interference) that MapPatternSet hands out by count. Not read by the game.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier 1
Fields.Description: The row can only be drawn for a pattern that already has this modifier (its Shifting Earth, event, boss or an earlier group's result). 0: no condition. Offline lottery input.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier 2
Fields.Description: Second required modifier, as Required Modifier 1. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 1
Fields.Description: The row is not drawn for a pattern that already has this modifier. 0: no condition. Offline lottery input.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 2
Fields.Description: Second excluded modifier, as Excluded Modifier 1. 0: no condition.

Fields.Name: Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier the pattern gets when this row is drawn (copied to LotResultMapPatternFlag Modifier). 0: none (the row only sets its event flag, or means "nothing").

Fields.Name: Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag the pattern gets when this row is drawn (copied to LotResultMapPatternFlag Event Flag). Retail: 7600-7605 Shifting Earth, 8000-8011 buried treasure groups, 7700-7727 day events. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Chance of this row against the other rows of its group that are allowed for the pattern. Retail: 100 on most rows; 875/125, 80/20 and 50/50 splits on the variant groups.
